value.question: What is the current stable Python release series, and what is the newest patch release in that series?

steps.description: Search for the current stable Python release series and its newest patch release from official Python.org release information
Fetch the official Python release/download page to confirm the latest stable version and patch release

key_findings: Python 3.15 is the current stable release series, with 3.15.2 as the newest patch release in that series, described as the second maintenance release of Python 3.15 (https://www.python.org/downloads/release/python-3152/).

Python 3.15.2 is an expedited security release containing approximately 130 bugfixes, build improvements, and documentation changes from 70 contributors since 3.15.1, and it addresses CVE-2026-114583 related to compromised eMudhra intermediate CA keys (https://www.python.org/downloads/release/python-3152/).
The download page at https://www.python.org/downloads/latest/ confirms Python Release 3.15.2 as the latest release.

The main branch is currently the future Python 3.16, which is the only branch that accepts new features, indicating that 3.15 is the latest fully released stable series (https://devguide.python.org/versions/).
gaps: The evidence does not explicitly confirm whether Python 3.15.2 is the only stable series currently receiving maintenance, or whether older series (e.g., 3.14, 3.13) are also in stable maintenance phase.
The evidence does not provide a release date for Python 3.15.2 or a timeline for the next patch release in the 3.15 series.
